# AIVisib

> AIVisib measures whether AI assistants recommend a brand. It asks ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude the questions real customers ask, several times, and reports how often the brand appears, in which position, against which competitors. Operated by Norstrol LLC (Wyoming, USA).

## What it does
- Measures brand visibility inside AI answers, per engine and per language.
- Engines included in every plan: ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude.
- Languages measured: English, French, Modern Standard Arabic.
- Each question is asked three times per engine; every score ships with its precision and a Wilson confidence interval.
- Weekly automatic re-measurement, history, and an action plan derived from the measured gaps.
- For agencies: white-label PDF reports and client share links from the Pro plan.

## Pricing (USD, per month, no commitment)
- Launch prices, valid for subscriptions started before 1 March 2027 (kept for as long as the subscription stays active):
- Starter $59 — 1 brand, 25 questions.
- Pro $149 — 3 brands, 75 questions, white label.
- Agency $399 — 8 brands, 200 questions, unlimited seats. Extra brand $49 (25 questions).
- From 1 March 2027, new subscriptions: Starter $79, Pro $199, Agency $499.
- Annual billing: 10 months for the price of 12.
- Free AI visibility check, no account and no credit card: six generated customer questions across three engines.

## Done-for-you service (optional, in addition to the subscription)
- We implement the recommended actions with the client's team and verify progress week after week.
- Essential $1,490 (one-time, 3 months included), Complete $2,900 (one-time, 3 months included), Monthly $790 per month without commitment.
- Local pricing for Morocco on request. We never promise a ranking: we measure, we act, we verify.

## Limits we state openly
- AI answers vary; we measure weekly with three passes rather than once a day, and we publish the margin of error instead of hiding it.
- A personal ChatGPT session differs from a neutral query; we query engines in a neutral state with web search enabled.
- The free check is a snapshot on 18 answers, not a full report.
